claims: Disneyland ticket prices for 2026 range from $104 to over $224 for a 1-day, 1-park ticket based on demand using a 7-tier system.
Disneyland ticket prices increased in October 2025.
Disneyland kept the base price at $104 in October 2025.
Disneyland raised peak days prices in October 2025.
Disneyland's 1-Day, 1-Park tickets for adults 10+ range from $104 (Tier 0) to $224 (Tier 6) in 2026.
Park Hopper tickets add $70–$90 per day to base tickets.
Disneyland multi-day tickets range from 2-day ($235+) up to 5-day options.
Standard parking at Disneyland is $30 per day.
Children ages 3–9 can visit Disneyland for $50 per day with a 1-Day Park Hopper under the Kids' Summer Ticket Offer from May 22 to September 7, 2026.
Magic Key Passes are annual passes available for frequent visitors.
Magic Key Pass prices are increasing in late 2025.
A theme park reservation is required in addition to a ticket for entry at Disneyland
